title: Dougal Shaw (BBC News / Business Leader) — 'Corruption breaks the logic of capitalism'
summary: Dougal Shaw — journalist with a decade of entrepreneur interviews at BBC News and now Business Leader — publishes a Book Review of Incorruptible on LinkedIn Pulse, centering the public benefit corporation as the antidote to the fiduciary-duty trap.
blockquote: This 'corruption breaks the logic of capitalism,' Ries argues, in a striking sentence… The PBC is the critical antidote to the fiduciary duty trap, he believes. The approaches that save companies are not only proven, but also learnable.
